Newly Opened! 【1 Minute from Akabane Station / Private Rooms Available】 Enjoy an All-You-Can-Eat and Drink Course Featuring Authentic Free-Range Chicken Starting at JPY 3,000!

At our restaurant, you can enjoy "Miyazaki Jitokko" grilled to perfection over binchotan charcoal at temperatures exceeding 1000°C! We offer a variety of creative dishes, including juicy yakitori with...

Specialities

Food

"Enjoy Authentic 'Jidori' Grilled with Binchotan Charcoal at Akane-ya!"

Drink

"Cheers Today with Carefully Selected Shochu and Local Sake from Across the Country!"

Space

【Private Room with Door】A Cozy Space Illuminated by Soft Light

Set menu

All you can drink

Limited Time Only!!! "120-Minute A la Carte All You Can Drink Plan" with 100 varieties, including refreshing Lemon Sour, various Shochu, and Japanese Sake! JPY 2000 ⇒ JPY 980 On-the-Day OK! 【Same-Day Reservation OK! Earn points with online reservations!】

We are pleased to offer a fantastic all-you-can-drink plan! Our standard plan, usually priced at JPY 2,000, is now available for just JPY 980! On-the-day reservations and those with table-only bookings can also order the all-you-can-drink option. Enjoy our signature dishes at your leisure. On Fridays, Saturdays, and the day before holidays, the two-hour option is available for JPY 1,800. Add draft beer for an additional JPY 320 (tax included). Extensions may be possible depending on the day's circumstances!

ReserveSet menu details
JPY 2,000JPY980（Price including tax）per person

All you can drinkAll you can eat

■2.5H All You Can Eat and Drink "Akane Course" A satisfying course with original grilled vegetables, charcoal-grilled chicken skewers, kara-age, and unlimited potatoes! <7 Dishes> JPY 6000 ⇒ JPY 3500 [On-the-Day Reservations OK! Earn points with online reservations!]7 items

This is an affordable course that includes classic menu items as well as Miyazaki Jidori chicken. Enjoy a variety of exquisite dishes, such as juicy and tender Miyazaki Jidori grilled over binchotan charcoal and kara-age made with red sake. We highly recommend you give it a try! For the finale, choose between Hakata-style yakisoba or takana mentaiko fried rice.

ReserveSet menu details
JPY 6,000JPY3,500（Price including tax）per person

All you can drink

■3-Hour All-You-Can-Drink "Takumi Course" featuring Satsuma Jidori Charcoal Grilled Chicken and Seasonal Toyosu Fresh Fish Sashimi, etc. <8 Dishes> JPY 6000 ⇒ JPY 4000 【On-the-Day Reservations OK! Earn Points with Online Reservations!】8 items

Enjoy a banquet course with a three-hour all-you-can-drink option. Indulge in our signature dishes, including Chicken Nanban with homemade tartar sauce packed with vegetables, and fresh fish carpaccio sourced every morning. Our charcoal-grilled Miyazaki Jidori chicken is cooked to perfection, ensuring it is juicy and tender. Relax in our serene space, inspired by traditional Japanese aesthetics, and savor a luxurious moment.

ReserveSet menu details

Just a 1-minute walk from Akabane Station! Enjoy Sendai Beef Tongue and Aizu Horse Meat Sushi. ~Private rooms available~

Located just a minute's walk from Akabane Station, "Izakaya Motenashi-ya Akabane" is a hidden gem where you can indulge in the delicious flavors of Tohoku, featuring Sendai beef tongue, fresh sashimi,...

Specialities

Food

When it comes to Tohoku, it's all about 【Gyutan】! The authentic tongue shabu and thick-cut gyutan are delicious◎

Food

"Thick-cut Beef Tongue and Tongue Shabu with All-You-Can-Drink Course Starting at 3500 Yen"

Space

Private rooms designed with care, accommodating from 2 guests. Perfect for welcome and farewell parties, as well as business meetings!

Service

"Special Surprise Services for Birthdays and Anniversaries!"

Set menu

All you can drinkAll you can eat

Sunday to Thursday Only 【Most Popular All-You-Can-Eat】 Grilled Skewers Assorted Platter All 7 Dishes + 2 Hours All-You-Can-Drink Draft Beer JPY 4500 ⇒ JPY 35007 items

【Most Popular All You Can Eat】Enjoy a delightful assortment of grilled skewers in this all-you-can-eat plan! Plus, it includes a total of seven dishes, featuring seasonal appetizers and fried items. This popular plan also offers a two-hour all-you-can-drink option, making it a great deal. Perfect for banquets, gatherings, and girls' nights out! With generous portions, you're sure to be completely satisfied!

ReserveSet menu details
JPY 4,500JPY3,500（Price including tax）per person

All you can drink

Autumn/Winter Limited 'Hakata Motsunabe Course' - Enjoy Beef Tongue Dishes and Rich Motsunabe! 8 Dishes, 3-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 ⇒ JPY 40008 items

Perfect for banquets during the cold season! Enjoy a selection of eight popular dishes, featuring the rich and flavorful Hakata Motsunabe hot pot, Beef Tongue Carpaccio, and savory grilled Beef Tongue. To finish off, we offer either zosui (rice porridge) or champon noodles. With a three-hour all-you-can-drink option, this course is highly recommended for company parties, girls' nights out, and gatherings with friends.

ReserveSet menu details
JPY 5,000JPY4,000（Price including tax）per person

All you can drink

Choose Your Hot Pot Course with Free-Range Chicken Hot Pot and Sendai Beef Tongue Grilled Over Charcoal – 9 Dishes with 3-Hour All-You-Can-Drink for JPY 4,5009 items

Our venue is perfect for various occasions such as New Year parties, farewell parties, welcome parties, business gatherings, celebrations with friends, and birthday parties. We also highly recommend it for year-end parties!

ReserveSet menu details
